Command.Statement: SELECT NON EMPTY Hierarchize({DrilldownLevel({[Store].[USA].[CA].[San Francisco]})}) DIMENSION PROPERTIES PARENT_UNIQUE_NAME, [Store].[Store Name].[Store Sqft], [Store].[Store Name].[Store Type], [Store].[Store Name].[Has coffee bar], [Customers].[Name].[Gender] ON COLUMNS FROM [ZFMSALES] CELL PROPERTIES VALUE, FORMAT_STRING, LANGUAGE, BACK_COLOR, FORE_COLOR, FONT_FLAGS
